# BiliTerminal Revival

> BiliTerminal Revival（哔哩终端复活版）是面向智能手表、旧 Android 设备和特殊网络环境的轻量哔哩哔哩第三方客户端项目。

## Official website

- Homepage: https://jp.031030.xyz/
- Sitemap: https://jp.031030.xyz/sitemap.xml

## Project summary

- The project focuses on Android 4.0.4 and later, including low-memory phones, smart watches and other constrained devices.
- The client provides video browsing, playback, caching and account-related features subject to the capabilities of the target device and the upstream service.
- A restricted private relay may be used when a device cannot directly reach the upstream service. The relay is not the upstream service and is controlled by the project operator.
- The website is the authoritative source for current releases, announcements and service status.

## Naming

- BiliTerminal Revival
- 哔哩终端复活版
- BiliTerminal

## Notes

- This is an independent third-party project and is not an official Bilibili product.
- Do not treat cached release information as current; check the official website and its announcements for the latest version.
